veranderings.voor: Gister kon dit reën, en vandag
veranderings.na: Dit kan gister gereën het, en vandag
veranderings.rede: 'Gister kon dit reën' reads as 'yesterday it was able to rain'; 'kan ... gereën het' is the natural Afrikaans for a past possibility and keeps the hypothetical meaning.
'Een plek' stresses the number one where nothing is being counted; the indefinite article reads more naturally and keeps the meaning.
